name: provethebuy-monorepo
description: Open-source verification and dispute evidence for orders placed by AI agents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @provethebuy/verify && npm run build -w @provethebuy/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test -w @provethebuy/verify && npm test -w @provethebuy/cli && node scripts/check-vectors.mjs
scripts.example: npm run build && npm start -w provethebuy-example-express
